_readme: Vibe Programmer's book (B in game). One chapter per entry; each string in lines is one line (empty string = blank line). Rich text like bold works. Queries are checked against the puzzles by GuideTests (EditMode): keep every query on its own line starting with SELECT / INSERT / DELETE.
title: The Theory of Everything
subtitle: by Donnie Raymond (the future one)

chapters.title: Read this first
lines: If you're reading this, it worked. I'm you, a bit later, with fewer illusions and a much better grasp of SQL.
This book is everything I wish I'd known that night. Every floor, every computer, every query, every choice, and where each one ends up. Read as much or as little as you like. Nobody's marking it.
How the night goes
Floor 0 (General): learn to type a query, get a cable, hack the front desk terminal.
Floor 1 (Administration): find out who runs the building's power.
Floor 2 (Human Resources): find the switch, find a login for it. Then the first call that matters.
Floor 3 (Executive Offices): get today's server room code. Then the second call that matters.
Server room: one of four endings.
The three phone calls

Each floor's last call asks you to tell the kidnappers the truth or lie. Floor 1's call changes almost nothing (one line at the very end). Floor 2 and Floor 3 decide the ending. The chapter 'The four endings' has the full table.
Any query that gives the same rows works. The ones in here are the ones I typed. Copy them exactly if you're tired.
W / S: chapters.   PageUp / PageDown or the wheel: scroll.   B or Esc: close.

chapters.title: Floor 0 · General
lines: 1. Janitor's closet (top left of the lobby): use it to get your gear. Q next to the cart takes hold of it; Q again lets go. Doors: E with the cart in hand.
2. Push the cart to Dan's office (east side of the lobby). Hold F next to the spill at the far right of the office to mop it while Dan teaches Ryker. Remember Ryker. You'll see him again.
3. Head for the stairs (top right of the lobby). The phone rings. It's about Betty.
4. Back in Dan's office, use Dan's computer. Find everything about the new intern:
SELECT * FROM employees WHERE role = 'Intern'
5. Leave the office. The next call wants you plugged into a computer: you need a USB-C cable.
6. The staff lounge (west side) talks about the vending machine. It wants a coin: yours is in your locker in the janitor's closet. Buy the cable.
7. Another call. Tab opens your phone: install KODEX from the message they send.
8. The employee terminal is on the front desk. Wait for the receptionist to go on her rounds, put the cable in your hand (its number key) and use the terminal. KODEX hacks it: Floor 1 clearance.
9. KODEX's five lessons on the terminal:
SELECT * FROM staff
SELECT name, department FROM staff
SELECT name FROM staff WHERE floor = 1
SELECT name FROM staff WHERE department = 'Accounts' AND floor = 1
SELECT name FROM staff WHERE department = 'Records' OR department = 'Human Resources'
10. Elevator to Floor 1.

chapters.title: Floor 1 · Administration
lines: Keep the cart with you in staffed offices: with it you're furniture, without it you're a stranger. Use computers when nobody is looking.
Shortest route: SE (drawer and computer), SW (drawer), A, B, C, D, E, F, the lounge locker, the Manager's office, the washroom, the meeting room, the elevator.
Open office SE (patrolled). Left cabinet: a slip that says vendor V-207. Computer gives Office E's code, 2468:
SELECT * FROM helpdesk WHERE floor = 1 AND category = 'Electrical' AND status = 'Open'
Open office SW (patrolled). Left cabinet: Office A key. Computer is optional (the meeting room is booked all day):
SELECT * FROM room_bookings WHERE room = 'Meeting room' AND day = 'Tuesday'
Office A (Office A key). Computer gives Office B's code, 3172:
SELECT * FROM door_codes WHERE office = 'Office B' AND status = 'active'
Office B (keypad 3172). Drawers: Office C key. Computer (Facilities became part of HR):
SELECT subject, body FROM inbox WHERE sender = 'Facilities' OR sender = 'Linda Park'
Office C (Office C key; Omar patrols). Computer needs the V-207 slip; gives Office D's code, 5590:
SELECT * FROM invoices WHERE vendor_id = 'V-207' AND status = 'unpaid'
Office D (keypad 5590). Computer gives cost centre PF-02 (a printout, into your pockets):
SELECT department, cost_centre, floor FROM budget WHERE item = 'Building power'
Office E (keypad 2468). Right-hand shelf: Office F key. Computer (the plans moved to HR):
SELECT contents, location FROM archive WHERE contents = 'Electrical plans' OR contents = 'Generator manual'
Office F (Office F key; Tomas patrols). Computer: the manager's spare key is in lounge locker 4:
SELECT holder FROM key_register WHERE door = 'Manager office' AND status = 'spare'
Lounge: the staff lockers. Manager's key.
Manager's office (Manager's key). Computer needs PF-02. Main power is run by HR, in Plant room 2B:
SELECT * FROM building_systems WHERE system = 'Main power' AND cost_centre = 'PF-02'
Then search Linda's desk: a tape recorder.
Men's washroom: the end cubicle, with the tape recorder. Linda and Ken leave in a hurry. The meeting room is free.
Meeting room terminal: Human Resources clearance, then five lessons:
SELECT name FROM staff WHERE role LIKE '%Officer'
SELECT name, department FROM staff WHERE department IN ('Security', 'People & Facilities')
SELECT name FROM staff WHERE NOT department = 'Human Resources'
SELECT name, start_year FROM staff WHERE department = 'Human Resources' ORDER BY start_year
SELECT department, COUNT(*) FROM staff GROUP BY department

The call (walk back to the elevator): did you find out who runs the power? Truth or lie. Lying here only gets you told off: they say somebody is watching you, and at the very end they remind you. It changes nothing else. It's the game teaching you that these calls matter. The next two really do.

chapters.title: Floor 2 · Human Resources
lines: The Head of HR walks the corridors all night. If he sees you without your cart he chases you; he's slower than you. If he catches you, it's back to the elevator. Keep the cart with you out there.
The HR open office (right): four computers.
First watch the onboarding video on the conference room projector. It explains that 'Plant Room 2B' is really the Northgate plant. Until you've seen it, the site register makes no sense.
Site register (Northgate's address):
SELECT site, name, address FROM sites WHERE name LIKE '%Northgate%' AND type = 'Power generation'
Change requests (it's switched from this floor's breaker room):
SELECT ref, requested, summary FROM change_requests WHERE system IN ('Main power', 'Northgate') ORDER BY requested
Cleaning rota (the conference room plant needs a 'special clean'):
SELECT area, item, notes FROM cleaning_rota WHERE task LIKE 'Special%'
Door locks (the interview room locks from outside: 7341. Remember it):
SELECT room, code FROM door_locks WHERE room = 'Interview room' AND NOT status = 'expired'
The breaker panel (breaker room): it wants an authorised duty login. Reception's computer has the list. You need every clue first:
1. Printer room: the jammed policy page. The switch takes a login whose role ends in 'Engineer'.
2. The onboarding video (projector): Northgate was built in 2014 by the Night operations team. Night shift, started 2014.

3. The conference room plant (after the cleaning rota): sift the soil for a coin. Take the elevator down to Floor 0 and buy crisps from the vending machine. Give them to the hungry candidate on the HR sofa: half the logins are dead, only 'active' ones work.
4. The interview room computer: Bram Kowal is being sacked today and his login dies at noon. Also, the restructure file. Keep that in mind; it's leverage.
SELECT name, decision, notes FROM restructure WHERE NOT decision = 'keep'
Then reception's computer, every clue at once:
SELECT username, password FROM duty_logins WHERE role LIKE '%Engineer' AND shift = 'Night' AND start_year = 2014 AND status = 'active' AND NOT name = 'Bram Kowal'
i.vidal / Northgate-0914. Sorry, Ines.
The employee terminal (long hallway, centre table) BEFORE you touch the switch (no power, no terminal): Executive clearance and five lessons:
SELECT name FROM employees WHERE dept_id = 20
SELECT employees.name, departments.dept_name FROM employees JOIN departments ON employees.dept_id = departments.id
SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.id WHERE d.floor = 3
SELECT d.dept_name, e.name FROM departments d LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.dept_id = d.id
SELECT dept_name FROM departments ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 2
While you're on this floor: the torch is on the right-hand table of the long hallway. Take it now; you'll want it.

chapters.title: Floor 2 · The call (truth or lie)
lines: Log in at the breaker panel: the call. They want to know if you can switch the plant. This choice matters.
Tell the truth

They switch the building off themselves and tip off security. In the dark, security walks rounds; F flicks your torch at a spot and they go and look. Get to the elevator. The deal: overheat the server room on Floor 3, Betty goes home.
Truth here leads to Accomplice or The Last Query.
Lie
They tell you who their spy is: Ryker. He clears the floor shouting fire and comes for you.
1. Cut this floor's power at the breaker panel.
2. Get the torch (long hallway table) if you haven't.
3. Ryker is faster than you and keeps tracking you. Lockers hide you completely; plants hide you, but your eyes show.
4. F flicks the torch: Ryker goes to look where it lands. Lure him to the interview room and flick it inside. When he walks in, lock the door from outside (7341).
5. Through the door he begs, and lets slip MagiCorp's database login. Keep it. Don't tell the kidnappers.
6. Turn the power back on at the breaker panel. Your leverage (the restructure file) buys the same deal: the server room.
Lying here leads to Capitalist or Good Samaritan.
Then the elevator to Floor 3.

chapters.title: Floor 3 · Liam's keycard
lines: The call: the server room code changes every day, belongs to a different person each day, and it's encrypted. Liam's executive keycard decrypts it.
Liam paces by the windows, bottom left. He won't help. He threatens Betty. He's the boss's son, and he's behind all of this.
1. Three coins in plant pots: by the stairs, in Liam's window corner, in the lounge.
2. Lounge vending machine: a hot coffee.
3. Coffee in hand (its number key), talk to Liam. Splash.
4. He chases you (a bit slower than you). Run into the small meeting room and hide in the locker. Rooms without a locker are no good.
5. He goes to the far end: 'I know you're in here.' Slip out and lock the door from outside. He hands over his keycard to get out. He doesn't get out.
Caught: you start again in the lounge with a fresh coffee.
Before the lights go, security and an assistant only question you if you're without your cart.
The employee terminal (reception desk): Server Room clearance and three lessons. These are the ones the server room needs:
INSERT INTO visitors (id, name, status) VALUES (5, 'Sam Ortiz', 'in')
INSERT INTO archive (id, name) SELECT id, name FROM visitors WHERE status = 'left'
DELETE FROM visitors WHERE status = 'left'

chapters.title: Floor 3 · Today's code
lines: Executive office A (the orange room) is safe. It has the link station and, in the desk drawer, a pen drive.
The pen drive is a key map, but you can't read it here: take the elevator to Floor 2 and print it on HR's printer. Now you know which column points where:
rota.holder, leave.on_leave, leave.cover and badges.owner hold a staff_id (staff.staff_id). code_parts.card holds a badge_no (badges.badge_no).

The green computers each hold one table: boardroom long table = staff, boardroom side table = rota, open office left = leave, open office right = badges, executive office B = code_parts. The link station points one computer at another so a JOIN can see both.
Task 1, boardroom side table. Link station: side table reads from the boardroom long table. Then:
SELECT s.staff_id, s.name FROM rota r JOIN staff s ON r.holder = s.staff_id WHERE r.rota_day = 'Tuesday'
Priya Shah, 118. She's on leave.
Task 2, open office left. Link station: open office left reads from the boardroom long table. Then:
SELECT s.staff_id, s.name FROM leave l JOIN staff s ON l.cover = s.staff_id WHERE l.on_leave = 118 AND l.leave_day = 'Tuesday'
Marcus Hale, 205, covers her. It's his code.
Task 3, executive office B. Link station: office B reads from the open office right. Then:
SELECT c.position, c.cipher FROM code_parts c JOIN badges b ON c.card = b.badge_no WHERE b.owner = 205 AND b.status = 'active' ORDER BY c.position
V Q 3 L. Encrypted.
Back to the link station and decrypt with Liam's card. Go on. It won't work, and that's the point.

chapters.title: Floor 3 · Blackout and the door
lines: Liam's card is revoked. The CEO gets an alert: what is his son up to? He doesn't trust his own son. Then the lights go out.
In the dark: three security guards and the CEO himself hunt you. Only executive office A (safe) and the CEO's office can be entered. Caught: back to office A.
1. Torch: the emergency cabinet in office A. F flicks it to send hunters off to look.
2. The CEO's office (top left; open now): his keycard is on his desk. His laptop is on it too: read his mail. It's about MagiCorp. You need that for the Capitalist ending.
3. Link station, decrypt with the CEO's card. Your phone restarts and updates: Calls now works, and there's a bank app (INFI Bank).

4. The bank: your savings, and GyaraCorp (GYRA) and MagiCorp (MAGI) shares. You can only buy MagiCorp if you have Ryker's MagiCorp login (the lie on Floor 2) AND you've read the CEO's mail. You can buy them now or in the server room. It'd better be worth it.
5. Decrypt once more: 7302.
6. The server room door (right-hand side): keypad 7302. Then the call: did you get in? Truth or lie. This one decides the ending (see the next chapter).

chapters.title: The four endings
lines: Floor 2's call and Floor 3's call pick the ending. Floor 1's doesn't.
Floor 2 TRUTH + Floor 3 TRUTH: Accomplice.
Floor 2 TRUTH + Floor 3 LIE: The Last Query.
Floor 2 LIE + Floor 3 TRUTH: Capitalist, if you read the CEO's laptop mail. If you didn't, you'll get the feeling you missed something (his office), and it plays out as Accomplice.
Floor 2 LIE + Floor 3 LIE: Good Samaritan.
In the server room the GyaraDB console is on the desk, top left. You can't leave until it's done.
Fastest way to see all four: load your Floor 2 checkpoint and pick differently at the breaker panel, then pick differently at the server room door. Load Game keeps every floor you've reached.

chapters.title: Ending · Accomplice
lines: Floor 2 truth, Floor 3 truth.
The call: change of plan. They've sent a file to your phone. Plug into the GyaraDB console and upload it. It turns off the cooling.
1. Use the console. Press Enter to upload.
2. The racks cook. Every alarm in the building goes.
3. Betty is free. And somebody has to take the fall. Guess who's standing next to the smoking computer.
Betty lives. You don't go home.

chapters.title: Ending · The Last Query
lines: Floor 2 truth, Floor 3 lie.
You forgot about Ryker. He was watching you since HR. They know you lied. I'm not going to write down what happens next. I've read it enough times.
The console only runs DELETE. Anything else, you'll refuse. One table, gyaradb, is everything the company is. A WHERE only takes part of it; it wants all of it:
DELETE FROM gyaradb
Nobody wins this one.

chapters.title: Ending · Capitalist
lines: Floor 2 lie (Ryker's MagiCorp login), the CEO's laptop mail read, Floor 3 truth.

The call: you talk them out of burning the servers. Copy everything GyaraCorp has into MagiCorp, wipe it here, and they sell out Liam. They tell you to use the CEO's keycard. Daddy already suspects his son.
1. If you haven't bought MagiCorp shares yet, you'll stop yourself. Phone (Tab), INFI Bank, buy MagiCorp (MAGI). While it's still 83p.
2. Use the console. Copy all of it into MagiCorp's inbox first (deleting first is refused):
INSERT INTO magicorp_inbox SELECT * FROM gyaradb
3. Then wipe GyaraDB:
DELETE FROM gyaradb
4. Cut to the CEO's office. Watch Liam explain that it was a janitor.
Betty goes home. You get very, very rich. Nobody remembers your name. That's the best part.

chapters.title: Ending · Good Samaritan
lines: Floor 2 lie, Floor 3 lie.
They think you're stuck outside. Ryker's locked in an interview room. For the first time all night, nobody's watching you.
1. Use the console once: you'll think it through. Not the computer. The CEO.
2. Leave the server room. Floor 3 is dark again. Security is still hunting you; the CEO isn't, he's just walking around his own floor muttering. Torch and lockers, like before.
3. Find the CEO and talk to him (E). Two minutes. Tell him everything.
4. Cut to his office. He gets the location out of Liam and calls the police.
The only ending where everybody gets what they deserve.

chapters.title: The stars
lines: Eight stars, on the title screen under Extras, Achievements.
Four for reaching an ending on each difficulty: Vibe Programmer, Unlikely Programmer, Likely Programmer, Leet Programmer. Any ending counts.
Four for the endings: Accomplice, The Last Query, Capitalist, Good Samaritan.

One run can give you two (its ending and its difficulty). Four runs, one per difficulty, each with a different ending, and you're done. Use Load Game to replay the calls: every floor you reach stays loadable.

Likely Programmer: computers have a time limit (the bar at the top). Stay too long and somebody notices: back to the floor's elevator. Read the task, plan the query, then sit down. Stepping off only drains the bar slowly.
Leet Programmer: the same, and KODEX doesn't help at all. No lessons, no Knowledge pages, no clue lists, no hints. Every query in this book still works. You just don't have this book.
Extras, Artwork shows every picture you've seen. The endings unlock the rest.
